releaseDetails.title: Dashboard watchlist contrast fix
releaseDetails.summary: University dashboard watchlist rows now keep labels, details and statuses readable across themes and browsers.

sections.heading: Watchlist readability
sections.summary: The dashboard watchlist is readable in every supported browser.

items.title: Explicit light rows
items.description: Watchlist items define their own background, border and text colours instead of relying on native defaults.

items.title: Clear status context
items.description: Item titles, supporting counts and status badges maintain contrast inside the hero panel.

sections.heading: Shared dashboard styling
sections.summary: The same contrast-safe treatment is used across the application dashboard watchlist.

items.title: Stable layout
items.description: Spacing, alignment and status placement remain consistent on desktop and mobile widths.

items.title: No functional change
items.description: Existing watchlist links and status logic remain unchanged.

callout.title: JDD update required
callout.description: Deploy the matching JDD runtime endpoint before opening Audit Logs.
